info.title: Meith REST API
info.summary: The read and write surface a client, a bot or an integration talks to.
info.description: A token is a restriction on an actor, never a grant to one. Every request resolves the owner’s permissions and asks the Authorizer, exactly as a page does, in addition to checking the token’s scope — so a token can never reach anything its owner could not. Endpoints marked as readable without a token resolve as the board’s guest through that same path, which is why a private forum stays private to them.

Error.description: Every failure on every endpoint has this shape.

code.description: Stable and machine-readable. Branch on this, never on `message`.

message.description: For a human reading a terminal. Translated to the board’s language.

requestId.description: The board’s correlation id, for quoting in a report.

Forum.description: One forum, as the token’s owner may see it.

slug.description: The URL-safe form of the title.

parentId.description: The forum this one sits under, or `null` at the top.

depth.description: How far down the tree the forum sits; the top level is 0.

Identity.description: Who the caller is, and what this token may ask for.

userId.description: The account the token belongs to.

Member.description: A member’s public profile — the same fields the member page shows a visitor.

postCount.description: How many posts they have made.

lastActiveAt.description: When they were last seen, if the board records it.

Message.description: One private message, as one participant sees it. Reading marks it read.

copyId.description: The caller’s copy of the message, which folders and reads act on.

authorUserId.description: Who sent it, or `null` if the account is gone.

authorUsername.description: The sender’s name as it was at the time.

folder.description: Which of the caller’s folders this copy sits in.

role.description: How the caller is on the message.

receiptRequested.description: Whether the sender asked to be told it was read.

replyToId.description: The message this one replies to, if any.

readAt.description: When the caller read it, or `null`.

participants.description: Everyone on the message the caller may see.

MessageSummary.description: One row of a message folder. Listing does not mark anything read.

copyId.description: The caller’s copy of the message. Page on this.

folder.description: Which folder this copy sits in.

role.description: How the caller is on the message.

readAt.description: When the caller read it, or `null`.

counterparties.description: The other people on the message.

moreCounterparties.description: How many further names were not listed.

Participant.description: One person on a message. Blind copies are visible only to themselves and the sender.

role.description: How they are on the message.

threadId.description: The thread the poll is attached to.

closesAt.description: When voting closes, or `null` if it does not.

maxOptions.description: How many options one member may pick. 0 means no limit.

allowRevote.description: Whether a member may change their vote.

publicVotes.description: Whether the voters are named on each option.

votedOptionId.description: The first option the caller voted for, or `null`.

items.description: An option the caller voted for.

id.description: The option’s id. Vote with this.

label.description: The option as it is shown.

voters.description: Who voted for it, on a poll with public votes.

PollVoter.description: One named voter on a poll that makes its votes public.

votedAt.description: When they voted, or `null` if the board did not record it.

Post.description: One post, as the caller may see it.

number.description: Its position in the thread, counting from 1.

authorUserId.description: Who wrote it, or `null` if the account is gone.

authorUsername.description: The author’s name as it was at the time.

visibility.description: Whether the post is public, held, or removed.

forumId.description: The forum that thread is in.

excerpt.description: The matching passage, word-filtered as the board filters it.

targetId.description: The id of the thread or forum being followed.

href.description: Where it lives on the board.

mode.description: How the follower is told about new posts.

pending.description: Posts since the follower last caught up.

Thread.description: One thread, as the caller may see it.

slug.description: The URL-safe form of the title.

authorUserId.description: Who started it, or `null` if the account is gone.

authorUsername.description: The starter’s name as it was at the time.

viewCount.description: How many times it has been read.

isSticky.description: Whether it is pinned to the top of its forum.

isLocked.description: Whether it is closed to further replies.

visibility.description: Whether the thread is public, held, or removed.

lastPostAt.description: When it was last posted in.

x-rate-limit.description: Metered in units of work, not requests. A token spends against its own budget; an unauthenticated caller spends against a smaller one held per address prefix.
